weapon.d: If foe initiates combat and uses bow, dagger, magic, or staff, grants Def/Res+6 during combat.
If foe initiates combat and uses bow, dagger, magic, or staff, grants Def/Res+6 during combat.

At start of combat, if unit's HP ≥ 25%, inflicts Atk/Res-6 on foe during combat, deals damage = 20% of unit's Res (excluding area-of-effect Specials), reduces damage from foe's first attack by 7 ("first attack" normally means only the first strike; for effects that grant "unit attacks twice," it means the first and second strikes), and inflicts Special cooldown charge -1 on foe per attack during combat (only highest value applied; does not stack).

special.d: Boosts damage by 50% of unit's Res.
Boosts damage by 80% of unit's Res.

c.d: At start of turn, inflicts Res-3 on foes within 2 spaces through their next actions.
At start of turn, inflicts Atk/Res-3 on foes within 2 spaces through their next actions.
At start of turn, inflicts Atk/Res-4 on foes within 2 spaces through their next actions.
